observations: lines 191-298 disable trunk gradients/eval trunk modules in confidence-only flow
line 795 returns before diffusion and distogram training losses when train_confidence_only is active
Defines the native ConfidenceHead used for structural-confidence outputs
the AdamW branch constructs the optimizer from all parameters whose requires_grad flag is true
substring-based finetune parameter grouping begins only in the non-AdamW branch at lines 88-103
therefore finetune_params_with_substring alone is not proof of freezing under AdamW

study_decisions: Repeat this audit on the exact G1-pinned commit; do not substitute this moving upstream snapshot for backbone_lock.json.
Treat native confidence-only training as structural-confidence training, not as a binary PPI-label objective.
For B3, keep Protenix backbone parameters outside the optimizer and train a separately serialized PPI task head on frozen Protenix features.
Any future in-model head training must explicitly set and verify requires_grad for every named parameter and record zero gradients on frozen parameters.
